shortDescription.default: Agent Map for Copilot Studio agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

longDescription.default: A SharePoint Copilot UX component that shows an interactive map of a Copilot Studio agent: its skills, tools, knowledge sources, connected agents, topics, triggers, and evaluation sets, and how they connect. It reads Dataverse with the signed-in user's delegated identity.

features.title: Agent Map Copilot component
features.description: Deploys the Agent Map Copilot UX component.
